note: atomic_flag is the one lock-free type the standard guarantees; a spinlock is its textbook use.
wait with a predicate loops internally, which is what protects against spurious wakeups.
std::async may run the task on another thread or lazily on get(); std::launch::async forces the former.
A latch counts down once and cannot reset; a barrier resets automatically for the next phase.
lock_guard cannot unlock early; unique_lock can, which is why condition_variable needs the latter.
scoped_lock takes several mutexes at once and locks them in a deadlock-avoiding order.
jthread joins automatically on destruction and carries a stop_token no plain thread has.
Workers block on an empty queue via condition_variable instead of spinning, so idle costs nothing.
